name: I Am Fire Fighter
summary:
Become a fire fighter and answer the call in I Am Fire Fighter, fire rescue, emergency response, and action-packed rescue missions.

Step into dangerous fire emergencies, enter burning locations, fight spreading flames, rescue trapped civilians, and complete challenging fire fighter missions. Use fire fighter tools and firefighting equipment to control each fire, clear obstacles, and reach people in danger.

Take on 15 fire fighter rescue missions with civilian rescue, emergency rescue, first responder obje
